hypothesis: RUNTIME surface, one retrieval upgrade: deterministic request-scaffolding stripping in the fts lane query construction of the three term-search tools (search_sources / search_evidence / search_claims). Measured on the R0 gold-44 qrels: a natural-language question ('帮我找一篇…','…有哪些,给两条带引用') tokenizes into CJK bigrams of its request scaffolding, which flood the bm25 AND/OR match and bury content terms — verbatim-question union source R@20 is 0.29 while the same questions with scaffolding stripped score 0.33 (per-tool: evidence 0.19→0.28, sources 0.28→0.35), 4 wins / 31 ties / 0 losses. v7: before tokenization for the fts query, a fixed zh noise-phrase list (longest-first per CJK run) and a latin stopword list are removed; a query that strips to nothing falls back to the original (never an empty fts query). SCAN lanes are untouched — they keep matching the raw query, so the v4/v5/v6 fallback semantics and all existing fixtures are unchanged. OVP_ASK_QUERY_STRIP=0 restores exact v6 behavior. Honesty invariant preserved: the fts lane searches a SUBSET of the reported terms, so a result can never be driven by a term the payload says was omitted; the scan lane's matched_terms/query_terms_used semantics are untouched.

predicted_delta.coverage: gold-44 verbatim-mode replay (the production path measurement): union source R@20 moves from 0.29 toward the terms-mode 0.33, with the largest gains on claim_evidence (0.00→~0.18) and compare (0.00→~0.10) buckets; NO bucket may regress (exact/meta/source_scoped/recent hold). Fixture replay: a scaffolded CJK query over a title only reachable via content terms returns the source through the fts lane; an all-scaffolding query behaves exactly as v6.
predicted_delta.operational_reliability: zero new failure modes: stripping is a pure function ahead of the existing tokenizer; OVP_ASK_QUERY_STRIP=0 or any strip bug degrades to v6 term construction; no persisted state, no schema change, no new payload fields.

guardrails.fallback_is_v6: OVP_ASK_QUERY_STRIP=0, or a query that strips to nothing, yields byte-identical v6 fts queries; scan lanes never see the stripped query at all
guardrails.scan_lane_untouched: run_query substring matching, tag sweep, matched_terms, and coverage accounting are byte-identical to v6 — the strip applies ONLY where the fts query string is built
guardrails.honesty_subset: the fts lane searches a subset of the tokenizer's reported terms; query_terms_truncated semantics unchanged (the cap applies to the stripped term list, which is never larger)
guardrails.no_content_loss: the noise lists contain only request scaffolding and function words, maintained as named constants with unit tests; content terms (nouns, names, identifiers, all latin non-stopwords) always survive

eval_plan.replay_set: unit: strip cases (zh scaffolding, latin stopwords, mixed, all-scaffolding fallback, kill-switch off = identity); fts-lane e2e over a real shadow: scaffolded query recalls the source that its content terms match, kill switch restores v6 behavior; all prior v4/v5/v6 fixtures pass unmodified. Acceptance gate: gold-44 verbatim-mode before/after on the real vault — union source R@20 strictly improves, zero bucket regressions, per-question losses = 0.

rollback: Set OVP_ASK_QUERY_STRIP=0 (instant, no rebuild) or revert the strip call sites — three one-line call insertions plus one pure function; no persisted state.
